name: Turmeric toothpaste

lead: Turmeric toothpaste is a paste containing turmeric, homemade or commercial, said to whiten teeth and help gums.
No clinical studies of it for whitening were found. Reference sources report no high-quality evidence of health benefits for turmeric generally.

paras: Proponents point to anti-inflammatory and antibacterial claims. Evidence for these in general is described as low quality; no whitening mechanism has been demonstrated.
Turmeric is a strong yellow dye and colors materials. No toothpaste-specific harm data were found.

forums.title: Worthy vs. Worthless Vitamins: Your Guide

lead: Turmeric toothpaste is a homemade paste, or a commercial toothpaste, containing turmeric powder and is marketed or shared as a natural whitening product. The idea is counterintuitive, since turmeric is a strong yellow pigment.

Turmeric gets its color from curcumin, used as a food coloring and, historically, a dye [1]. Reference sources report no high-quality clinical evidence that turmeric or curcumin treats any disease [1]. No clinical trials of turmeric toothpaste for whitening were found.

paras: Proponents say turmeric has anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties that brighten teeth and soothe gums, and recipes often combine it with coconut oil or baking soda. Turmeric has long been used in Ayurveda and other traditional systems, but the European Medicines Agency found insufficient evidence of efficacy, allowing only traditional-use oral forms for mild digestive complaints [1].
No studies found. Turmeric and curcumin have been studied in many low-quality trials for other conditions, without good evidence of benefit [1]. Established whitening relies on peroxide [2].

Turmeric is a staining pigment, used in dyes and as a pH indicator paper that turns reddish-brown in alkaline conditions [1]. High-bioavailability turmeric supplements have been linked to rare liver injury [1]; this concerns ingestion rather than toothpaste. No studies of toothpaste-specific risks were found.
Turmeric paste appears in natural-whitening tips. No community-sourced material was available for citation here.
